results.title: Accelerator management
results.description: Learn how to effectively deploy and manage accelerators for large language models, including selecting the right hardware, optimizing usage, and navigating cloud-hosted and on-premises strategies. Understand key considerations for maximizing utilization, minimizing idle time, and reducing costs for LLM inference workloads.

scores.rationale: 加速器选择、利用率、空闲成本与云上/本地策略是大模型推理基础设施的核心知识。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Autoscaling self-hosted Llama models》、《Cost comparison and basic deployment patterns》，本资料的独立增量是：加速器选择、利用率、空闲成本与云上/本地策略是大模型推理基础设施的核心知识。

results.title: Autoscaling self-hosted Llama models
results.description: Learn how to optimize autoscaling for self-hosted Llama models by understanding key metrics, implementation strategies, and operational best practices to balance GPU costs and inference performance. Discover how to deploy a simple autoscaled Llama inference service using managed platforms and production-ready configurations.

scores.rationale: 基于延迟、吞吐和 GPU 指标扩缩自托管推理，直接解决性能与成本平衡。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Accelerator management》、《Cost comparison and basic deployment patterns》，本资料的独立增量是：基于延迟、吞吐和 GPU 指标扩缩自托管推理，直接解决性能与成本平衡。

results.title: Cost comparison and basic deployment patterns
results.description: Learn how to compare different compute options for Llama inference and determine the most cost-effective infrastructure choice for your specific use case by evaluating key metrics and variables that drive infrastructure costs. Understand the cost components and pricing considerations for managed hosted APIs, serverless GPU, GPU rental, and bare metal ownership to make an informed decision.

scores.rationale: 托管 API、无服务器 GPU、租用与裸金属的成本构成比较具有广泛选型价值。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Accelerator management》、《Autoscaling self-hosted Llama models》，本资料的独立增量是：托管 API、无服务器 GPU、租用与裸金属的成本构成比较具有广泛选型价值。

results.title: Cost projection
results.description: Learn how to project the total cost of operating large language models (LLMs), including costs for hosted APIs, cloud deployments, and on-premises deployments, and understand key cost drivers and optimization strategies. Understand the cost implications of different LLM use cases, such as chatbots, summarization, and code generation, to make informed decisions about LLM deployment.

scores.rationale: 按请求、token、硬件和运维变量预测不同 LLM 场景总成本，是部署规划核心方法。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Accelerator management》、《Autoscaling self-hosted Llama models》，本资料的独立增量是：按请求、token、硬件和运维变量预测不同 LLM 场景总成本，是部署规划核心方法。

results.title: Infrastructure migration
results.description: Learn how to migrate from OpenAI to Llama models through a four-phase approach: assessment, proof of concept, gradual migration, and optimization. Discover key considerations, tools, and best practices for a successful infrastructure migration.

scores.rationale: 评估、PoC、渐进迁移和优化四阶段路径提供从闭源 API 迁移到 Llama 的完整决策框架。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Accelerator management》、《Autoscaling self-hosted Llama models》，本资料的独立增量是：评估、PoC、渐进迁移和优化四阶段路径提供从闭源 API 迁移到 Llama 的完整决策框架。

results.title: Private cloud deployment for Llama models
results.description: Learn how to deploy Llama models in private cloud environments across AWS, Azure, and GCP with advanced security features and configuration options, and optimize costs through resource tagging, monitoring, and optimization strategies. Understand various architecture patterns, including VPC-isolated, cross-region, and multi-cloud deployments, for different organizational needs.

scores.rationale: VPC 隔离、跨区域和多云私有部署模式兼顾安全、成本与数据边界。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Accelerator management》、《Autoscaling self-hosted Llama models》，本资料的独立增量是：VPC 隔离、跨区域和多云私有部署模式兼顾安全、成本与数据边界。

results.title: Production pipelines for Llama deployments
results.description: Learn how to design and implement production-ready Llama pipelines that handle data processing, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring at scale, and optimize resource utilization and cost efficiency. Discover strategies for building resilient pipelines, including data ingestion, validation, preprocessing, distributed fine-tuning, and deployment techniques.

scores.rationale: 从数据验证、分布式微调、评测到部署监控的生产流水线覆盖完整生命周期。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Accelerator management》、《Autoscaling self-hosted Llama models》，本资料的独立增量是：从数据验证、分布式微调、评测到部署监控的生产流水线覆盖完整生命周期。

results.title: Self-hosted Llama deployments for regulated industries
results.description: Learn how to deploy self-hosted Llama models for regulated industries like healthcare, ensuring data sovereignty and compliance with regulations such as HIPAA and GDPR. Discover various architecture patterns, model selection, security controls, and deployment approaches to optimize performance and maintain regulatory compliance.

scores.rationale: 受监管行业自托管将数据主权、HIPAA/GDPR、安全控制与模型部署架构结合。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Accelerator management》、《Autoscaling self-hosted Llama models》，本资料的独立增量是：受监管行业自托管将数据主权、HIPAA/GDPR、安全控制与模型部署架构结合。

results.title: Security in production
results.description: Learn how to implement a comprehensive security framework for Llama applications in production environments, covering infrastructure, data, application, and operational security to mitigate risks and protect AI systems. Follow a defense-in-depth strategy to secure your Llama deployment.

scores.rationale: 基础设施、数据、应用和运营四层纵深防御是生产 Llama 安全的核心框架。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Accelerator management》、《Autoscaling self-hosted Llama models》，本资料的独立增量是：基础设施、数据、应用和运营四层纵深防御是生产 Llama 安全的核心框架。

results.title: Versioning, updates and migration
results.description: Learn how to effectively migrate between different versions of Llama models by understanding their versioning system and implementing a strategic migration plan, and discover how to evaluate performance, assess trade-offs, and optimize prompts for optimal results. Understand Llama's versioning, compare model capabilities using model cards, and plan your migration with a step-by-step guide.

scores.rationale: 版本能力比较、评测、提示适配和分阶段迁移共同定义模型升级方法。

results.uniqueDelta: 相较于《Accelerator management》、《Autoscaling self-hosted Llama models》，本资料的独立增量是：版本能力比较、评测、提示适配和分阶段迁移共同定义模型升级方法。
